name: Amaze Communications
summary: Sydney dial-up/prepaid ISP (Amaze Technologies Pty Ltd, est. 1996); acquired Holodoc OZ 2000; ceased trading as an ISP 8 Oct 2002 (customer base to SIS Group Pty Ltd, t/a DialUp ThePlaNet), ABN cancelled 2003. NOTE: unrelated to AMAZE CO PTY LTD (ACN 666 475 903), a separate company registered 2023.
